paragraphs.text:
You pick Sylvia up off the ground. Her eyes stare through you, 
vacant. Norman sets up camp, attempting to create a familiar 
environment. After a few hours in her bedroll, Sylvia seems to 
come out of it.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 324; if the result is odd, go to 237.
